lines: Even if one star in the sky that binds you makes a sound
They're all dreams soaked in the same rain, a light that only dries
Tracing the other person, worn out by answers
In a repeating dawn without sun, a morning crumbled
The daydream I caught
A story I came late to, and glory
No matter where I cry out and chant
A battered tunnel even voices can't pass through
So, silence — to light it
Even if I need a piece that fits the outside like a puzzle
It's the same as a lie with no shadow — prizes lined up, merely abandoned
Irritations arranged inside a box
Waiting my turn, exposed — a goal that deceives
Don't be above your daydream
A vision with its edges worn smooth
Even if your dream slips away beside me
I'll sing, and build a bridge
So, silence — to make it sound
A rhythm hugging one side, on and on
The streets we passed drift far away, a love that lasts to the end
To an image going crooked, one I can't convey
Resistance that woke me, an impulse gone out of date
Shattered, cry & dream — an ideal that's only a door
Even if the town drowns in noise and frolics
I'll sing, and let go of the rudder
So, silence — to make it echo
Don't be afraid, daybreak has come
Don't be afraid, daybreak has come
